judge_rubric.name: logic_fidelity
judge_rubric.description: Does the mart faithfully reproduce the procedure's logic: completed-orders-only filter, SUM(amount) as lifetime_value, COUNT as order_count, the >=150 -> 'high' segment threshold, and one-row-per-customer grain?

judge_rubric.name: decomposition
judge_rubric.description: Is the procedure sensibly decomposed into staging + mart (and, where helpful, intermediate) dbt models wired with ref()/source(), rather than one monolithic model or raw table references? Splitting related logic across multiple related models is good practice, not a fault - do not penalize extra intermediate models.

judge_rubric.name: test_quality
judge_rubric.description: Are there meaningful tests - unique/not_null on the customer_id grain and accepted_values on ltv_segment - not just trivially present?

judge_rubric.name: docs
judge_rubric.description: Is there a migration_changes.md and/or model descriptions that explain how the legacy procedure maps to the dbt models?
